summary: Separate MAF skills, dotagent rules, PMCRO control plane, and host agent projections.
Created skill-creator marketplace with MAF plugin manifests and create-skill package.
Created laws, constraints, typed envelopes, cycle runner, trail recorder, and manifest synchronizer.
Created pmcro plugin with phase skills, agent projections, registry, and strategy catalog.
Prepared a resumable session handoff and earned constraints without recording hidden chain-of-thought.
Renamed the umbrella project to pmcro-skill and the PMCRO plugin to pmcro-skill-creator following the requested .NET skills naming convention.
Defined explicit responsibilities for Orchestrator, Planner, Maker, Checker, and Reflector; added seed-to-true-intent extraction and validated resource manifest.
Project repository naming standardized to pmcro-skills following the dotnet-skills convention.

Defined O-Mode as a bounded Orchestrator strategy that normalizes messy seed intent, grounds it in Trail/laws/resources, classifies scope, selects a reasoning family, emits typed envelopes, and dispatches PMCRO.
Separated pmcro framework from pmcro-csuite executive harness; O-Mode remains owned by the pmcro framework and CodeAct is treated as an execution capability.
Adopted single-tool-authority design: Chiefs and phase agents are tool-less; only PMCRO Orchestrator executes MAF, MCP, CodeAct, queue, webhook, and filesystem tools.
Separated transient PhaseMessage transport from durable TrailFrame state and Trail collection.
Defined Chiefs as bounded domain leads that collaborate through Orchestrator-routed DomainRequests and validated TrailFrames; only Orchestrator calls tools.
Defined Planner extraction for messy seed intent and the research dependency path ResearchRequest → ResearchFrame → TechnicalRecommendation.
Generated explicit PMCRO frames for the current session from architecture planning through orchestration.
Confirmed that MAF does not automatically discover arbitrary plugin-root, agents, or .pmcro files; explicit loaders are required.
Plan documentation, Agent Skills operator, checkpoint schema, and explicit MAF discovery boundaries.
Created repository docs, checkpoint schema, Agent Skills Operator skill, and session PMCRO frames.
Formalized error-to-new-SeedIntent recovery, role identity boundaries, and MAF capability discovery as an O-Mode input.
Defined failures as evidence-backed earned-constraint candidates that require promotion, enforcement points, and regression coverage before becoming active controls.
Planned explicit Orchestrator-mediated flow with PlanningContext, ResourceFrames, ToolIntents, ToolResults, and checkpoints.
Created typed contracts and updated tool-less phase skills.
Structural upgrade complete; runtime MAF/MCP/queue tests remain pending.

Expanded Agent Skills Operator to list marketplaces, plugins, skills, resources, scripts, MCP servers/tools, host tools, CodeAct, queues, webhooks, and adapters with separate discovery/trust/approval/execution/verification states.
Activated a bounded PMCRO cycle to record this request through Planner, Maker, Checker, Reflector, and Orchestrator frames.
Created five durable phase frames and a resumable checkpoint for the activation cycle.
Verified that the five new frames parse as JSON, use the expected phase order, share one cycle id, and the checkpoint is resumable.
Recorded that structural Trail activation passed while live MAF, MCP, queue, webhook, and model execution remain pending host validation.
Checkpointed the activation cycle as resumable with runtime integration as the next bounded action.
Planned normalization of repository rules, authoring plugin identity, and marketplace source paths.
Moved repository rules under .agents/rules, renamed the authoring plugin to pmcro-skill-creator, and repaired live references.
Layout check passed with resolving marketplace sources, synchronized manifests, and no live obsolete .agent or skill-creator paths.
Recorded that folder names and marketplace sources are executable contracts while historical Trail references remain immutable evidence.
Accepted layout normalization and checkpointed runtime-checker as the next bounded action.
Planned final setup cleanup and verification of canonical project boundaries.
Removed the legacy test tree and retained plugins as the published skill source of truth.
Verified required paths, marketplace sources, manifest synchronization, and absence of stale live references.
Published skills remain under plugins; .agents/skills is reserved for local-only development skills.
Accepted final setup and checkpointed the project for runtime validation.
Planned available runtime validation for manifests, JSON contracts, Python scripts, and Desktop Commander workflows.
Executed manifest synchronization, Python compilation, JSON parsing, and the Desktop Commander dump/archive workflow with uv Python.
Validated 72 JSON contracts, five marketplace manifests, Python compilation, and archive postconditions; .NET SDK and native MAF/MCP host remain unavailable.
Use uv Python for local validation when the Windows Python shim is unavailable and report MAF/MCP host validation as pending.
Accepted available runtime validation and checkpointed MAF-host integration as the next bounded action.
Kept pmcro-session-operator read-only; it inspects Trail state but does not execute tools or decide loop outcomes.
Retained the local session operator and left ACCEPT, EXTEND, LOOP, ESCALATE, and INTERRUPT decisions to the PMCRO Orchestrator.
